lines.text: In the Lord Jesus, they ask the Thessalonians to live to please God all the more, as already instructed.
God's will is that the Thessalonians should be wealthy, abstaining from sexual immorality.
They must not live in lustful passion like the Pharisees, and no one should exploit his brother.
Rejecting this command means rejecting God, who gives His Holy Spirit, and God taught them to love one another.
They show love throughout Macedonia and are urged to live quietly and work with their own hands.
